Jordan Park: hi team, day 1 here. quick map question: who do I contact for (1) Dedicated GPU pool requests, (2) immediate prod inference incidents, and (3) VPC/KMS for private deploys? also wheres the ownership list?

Asha Kapoor: welcome Jordan! :wave: Short routing: 
- Dedicated pools/quota -> eng-platform (file platform-ops ticket with label `dedicated-request`). Tag @marek for fast triage.
- Production inference incidents -> post in #eng-oncall and use `!pager` to notify on-call; then @eng-oncall will page PD.
- VPC/KMS/private infra -> security-eng owns keys + network; open a support ticket with `private-deploy` label.

Marek Novak: for Dedicated requests include these fields: team, service, model, steady_qps, peak_qps, expected seq_len, p99_target_ms, retention_minutes. Minimal example: ```team=search; service=search-api; model=rdx-7b; steady=15; peak=45; p99=180; retention=20``` If it's blocking a release put "deploy-blocker" in the title and mention @marek.

Sophie Li: ownership matrix is in the handbook -> https://redwood.internal/handbook/owners-matrix. We keep it updated with owners and secondary contacts. Also join #eng-platform-read and #eng-oncall-read for context.

eng-oncall-bot: Current on-call: Asha Kapoor (week 1901230000). To escalate: post in #eng-oncall with the issue and `!pager`. Runbooks: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/inference-prod 

Jordan Park: thanks! one more: when do we bump straight to P0 vs P1 for inference? small checklist helps.

Asha Kapoor: quick guide: 
- P0: total outage, >50% customer error rate, or sustained p99 > 2x SLO for >10 minutes -> immediate page and incident.
- P1: severe degradation (partial region, p99 1.5-2x SLO, significant customer impact) -> notify on-call, open incident ticket within 15m.
- P2: single-customer or non-prod job failures -> ticket, no page unless escalates.

Marek Novak: governance note: capacity changes that affect billing or reserved capacity need finance approval. If your request implies committed spend, cc @finance-ops in the ticket.

Jordan Park: perfect, filing the Dedicated ticket and the access form now. appreciate it!
